actions.more: The note column is shown here only to a reader with a token, because GET /actions is on no sharing allowlist.

en: What is recorded when someone acts?
How is ρ counted from these rows?
es: ¿Qué se registra cuando alguien actúa?
¿Cómo se cuenta ρ a partir de estas filas?
id: Apa yang dicatat saat seseorang bertindak?
Bagaimana ρ dihitung dari baris-baris ini?

actions.quote: The ρ instrument: what happened after an alert, one row per answer.
actions.title: The table ρ is counted from

bar.more: It says which node this is, which door you are on and how fresh the readings are. Locked means this screen holds no token: Set up › This screen unlocks it.

en: Why does the bar say locked?
How fresh are the readings on this page?
es: ¿Por qué arriba dice locked?
¿De cuándo son las lecturas de esta página?
id: Mengapa di bagian atas tertulis locked?
Seberapa baru bacaan di halaman ini?

bar.quote:
The bar runs along the top of every door but the Wall: the node's name and place, the five doors in the order Now,
Place, Node, Data, Wall, then an as-of line (`LIVE · as of 19:00`, or `CAPTURE` on a fixture, with `· locked` on a
screen without a token)
bar.title: The bar at the top

bot.more: An act recorded through the bot lands in this ledger like one pressed on this page, with the person's own words as its note.
bot.page_title: The bot and the model ladder

en: How do I ask the bot on Telegram?
Which model answers, and where does it run?
es: ¿Cómo pregunto al bot en Telegram?
¿Qué modelo responde, y dónde se ejecuta?
id: Bagaimana cara bertanya ke bot di Telegram?
Model mana yang menjawab, dan di mana ia berjalan?

bot.quote:
Somebody in the house asks "is the air bad right now?" on Telegram and gets an
answer read from the node's own tools. Somebody says "I closed the windows" and the bot records it, in their words,
as an act.
bot.title: An answer in the household's words

buttons.more: The first press asks for a name, and this browser keeps it for the next. The labels come from the node, and an answer needs the act token from another device. Done and Not now answer the ask, so they count in ρ when the event was sent at act level; Doesn't fit does not.

en: What does each of the three buttons record?
What happens to the card when I put it off?
es: ¿Qué registra cada uno de los tres botones?
¿Qué pasa con la tarjeta si la dejo para más tarde?
id: Apa yang dicatat oleh masing-masing dari tiga tombol itu?
Apa yang terjadi pada kartu jika saya menundanya?

buttons.quote: **Done**, **Not now** and **Doesn't fit** each write one answer to the event: who pressed, and when. Done closes the loop. Not now holds the card, muted, for three hours unless the reading reaches danger. Doesn't fit asks one optional question, what you did instead, and keeps the answer as the note.
buttons.title: Done, Not now and Doesn't fit

cards.more: The house is the solid line, the ring dotted, the street and the region dashed, the line itself dashed red. Where a distance has no source its trace is absent and the legend says which one.

en: Which kind of card is this?
Why are there only four kinds?
es: ¿Qué tipo de tarjeta es esta?
¿Por qué hay solo cuatro tipos?
id: Kartu jenis apa ini?
Mengapa hanya ada empat jenis?

cards.quote: Four card kinds and no fifth: readout, stack, series, row. A gap in a series is a gap in the line, never a ramp across a line nobody measured. The node's own words are never uppercased: `µg/m³` once became `MG/M³` on the hero, a factor of a thousand.
cards.title: Four card kinds and no fifth

cell.more: Resolution 8 is coarser than the rounding already applied to the node's position, so the cell drawn on the ground puts nothing back that the node had held out.

en: How big is the cell this node stands in?
Who can see this cell and who cannot?
es: ¿Qué tamaño tiene la celda donde está este nodo?
¿Quién puede ver esta celda y quién no?
id: Seberapa besar sel tempat node ini berdiri?
Siapa yang bisa melihat sel ini dan siapa yang tidak?

cell.quote:
**The H3 cell.** The node stands in a hexagon of the H3 grid at resolution 8, with an edge of about half a
kilometre: 497 m for node #1's cell, measured from the cell itself. The page prints it in the mono as a
fifteen-character id such as `8895a4c843fffff`, with its edge length beside it.
cell.title: The cell this node stands in

claims.more: The line above the fold names the widest and the narrowest footprint; the fold holds all six. Each card counts its cells at the rung you are on, so the count moves with the ladder.

en: How much ground does this number cover?
Why does the number change with the rung?
es: ¿Cuánto terreno cubre esta cifra?
¿Por qué la cifra cambia con el peldaño?
id: Seberapa luas wilayah yang dicakup angka ini?
Mengapa angkanya berubah dengan anak tangga?

claims.quote: "Whose word, over how much ground" covers with H3 cells the six footprints this node already declares, from `COAST_MAX_KM` for the sea to the three decimals `/health` rounds a position to. Each produces one number, and its card says how many cells of the rung you are on that one number has to cover.
claims.title: One number, over how much ground

containment.more: That is the documentation's example resolution line. The one on Network, under What each rung is worth, is tonight's, read from this node, and when the neighbouring rungs give the same answer the page says so.

en: How many stations fall in this node's cell?
Why is a cell exact in the index and not on the ground?
es: ¿Cuántas estaciones caen en la celda de este nodo?
¿Por qué una celda es exacta en el índice y no sobre el terreno?
id: Berapa stasiun yang jatuh di sel node ini?
Mengapa sel tepat di indeks tetapi tidak di lapangan?

containment.quote: At resolution 8 one cell is 639,778 m² on node #1, about 0.64 km², with an edge of 497 m. The resolution line counts the cells this node's stations with a coordinate fall in, how many of those stations sit in the node's own cell, and how many of those are its own.
containment.title: Exact in the index, approximate on the ground

counted.more: `planetai sensors` prints these stations one line each, with `yours` or `reference` beside the id, and GET /sensors is the route a script reads them from. Only the ones in this node's custody can make a cell say live.

en: Which of these stations are ours and here?
What makes a sensor counted?
es: ¿Cuáles de estas estaciones son nuestras y están aquí?
¿Qué hace que un sensor cuente?
id: Stasiun mana yang milik kita dan ada di sini?
Apa yang membuat sebuah sensor dihitung?

counted.quote:
Once a sensor of yours is polled, the rules
have a room to fire on, and its hourly means can count toward this place's cell in the Fab City Index. Whether
they count is decided by two fields on the sensor's row, `local` and `custody`.
counted.title: Yours, here, and counted

current.more: A heat alert is a condition that holds for hours; a cooking spike is an event with a cooldown. The schema does not yet know an alert can clear, so the page says which it is.

en: Is this a condition or an event?
Why does the node not alert on every reading?
es: ¿Es una condición o un evento?
¿Por qué el nodo no avisa con cada lectura?
id: Apakah ini keadaan atau kejadian?
Mengapa node tidak memberi peringatan untuk setiap bacaan?

current.quote:
The dashboard marks
an open act-level alert as *current* only while its condition still holds (the house over the line, or the
alert under two hours old), and otherwise says the reading came back on its own and the alert is still open.
current.title: Conditions that are not events

custody.more: Your own instruments are drawn in ink on this page, the borrowed ones faint, and what only the satellite knows in orange.

en: Which sensors does this node count as its own?
Why is a neighbour's sensor not counted?
es: ¿Qué sensores cuenta este nodo como suyos?
¿Por qué no se cuenta el sensor de un vecino?
id: Sensor mana yang dihitung node ini sebagai miliknya?
Mengapa sensor tetangga tidak dihitung?

custody.quote:
**`custody`.** A generated column: `kind = 'child' OR (local AND kind <> 'peer')`. The only thing a cell may
count. Custody splits geography from responsibility: a peer's station can be closer than your own kit and
still never be counted.
custody.title: Custody: who may be counted

data-api.more: This tab lists every route on this node, one line each, with a search. The doors read the same routes a script or a spreadsheet can.

en: How can I read this data from my own tools?
Which routes need a token?
es: ¿Cómo leo estos datos desde mis propias herramientas?
¿Qué rutas necesitan token?
id: Bagaimana saya bisa membaca data ini dari alat saya sendiri?
Rute mana yang memerlukan token?

data-api.quote: Every node exposes the same API on port 8080. The dashboard, the `planetai` command, the MCP tools, a NAS pulling backups, Home Assistant and a parent node are all clients of it, and none of them has a private path in.
data-api.title: The API

data-head.more: The head counts what the tabs draw, the hourly values, the model and satellite values and the decisions, and links to today's open file.

en: How much has this node recorded in the last day?
Can I download our data?
es: ¿Cuánto ha registrado este nodo en el último día?
¿Puedo descargar nuestros datos?
id: Berapa banyak yang dicatat node ini dalam sehari terakhir?
Bisakah saya mengunduh data kami?

data-head.quote:
Every reading the node holds, one tab at a time, routed `#data/<tab>`. The tab bar is sticky; on a phone it wraps into
44 px targets.
data-head.title: Everything the node holds

data-images.more: The pictures stay on this node, cleaned of EXIF and GPS. What the image model saw counts only once a person here confirms it.

en: What did the image model see in our photos?
How do I confirm what a photo shows?
es: ¿Qué vio el modelo de imágenes en nuestras fotos?
¿Cómo confirmo lo que muestra una foto?
id: Apa yang dilihat model gambar di foto-foto kami?
Bagaimana cara memastikan isi sebuah foto?

data-images.quote: **Images**, newest first: when and who, what took it, the note, what the image model saw and whether somebody here confirmed it. A row opens the image to edit, confirm or delete.
data-images.title: Images

data-ledger.more: An answer from this page, Telegram, the radio or an agent lands here as one row. The newest is at the top.

en: Who answered the last alert?
What have we done this week?
es: ¿Quién respondió la última alerta?
¿Qué hemos hecho esta semana?
id: Siapa yang menjawab peringatan terakhir?
Apa saja yang sudah kami lakukan minggu ini?

data-ledger.quote: every decision, newest first, a run of the same answer as one row ("decided ×10"), who answered in words, and a filter by stage. Without a token, only the time and the stage
data-ledger.title: The ledger

data-models.more: A model is partial whatever its quality, so these values sit apart from what the house measures.

en: What does the forecast say for here?
How is a model different from a sensor?
es: ¿Qué dice el pronóstico para aquí?
¿En qué se diferencia un modelo de un sensor?
id: Apa kata prakiraan untuk tempat ini?
Apa bedanya model dengan sensor?

data-models.quote: one table: a row per value the models and the satellite give for this point, how often it is fetched, its unit
data-models.title: Models and satellite

data-perday.more: Here those counts are a table, a row a day, with the hours over the line out of the hours read, for each issue drawn by the hour.

en: Which days had the most bad hours?
Are the bad hours getting fewer?
es: ¿Qué días tuvieron más horas malas?
¿Hay cada vez menos horas malas?
id: Hari apa yang paling banyak jam buruknya?
Apakah jam-jam buruk makin berkurang?

data-perday.quote:
The figure at the end of each row is the node's own count of
hours over the line that day, from `GET /issues/days`.
data-perday.title: Hours over the line, per day

data-readings.more: Each tile is one kind of reading with the median of its sources now. With the token a small trace shows its last 24 hours.

en: What does this house measure?
What does each of these readings mean?
es: ¿Qué mide esta casa?
¿Qué significa cada una de estas lecturas?
id: Apa saja yang diukur di rumah ini?
Apa arti masing-masing bacaan ini?

data-readings.quote: every kind of reading as a tile, with the median of its sources' 15-minute means now.
data-readings.title: Every kind of reading

data-sources.more: All the sources share one scale so you can compare them, and a spike above it is printed with its number, so one spike cannot flatten the rest.

en: Do our sensors agree with the public stations?
Which source reads the highest today?
es: ¿Coinciden nuestros sensores con las estaciones públicas?
¿Qué fuente marca más alto hoy?
id: Apakah sensor kami sejalan dengan stasiun publik?
Sumber mana yang bacaannya paling tinggi hari ini?

data-sources.quote: Press one to draw every source that reads it over 24 hours on one scale, each linked to where its source publishes it (the hourly table needs the token).
data-sources.title: Every source, a row each

data-things.more: Only a thing you mark to lend or give is ever published, and nothing else about your things leaves this machine.

en: Which of our things are rarely used?
How do I offer something to lend?
es: ¿Qué cosas nuestras casi no usamos?
¿Cómo ofrezco algo para prestar?
id: Barang kami mana yang jarang dipakai?
Bagaimana cara menawarkan barang untuk dipinjamkan?

data-things.quote: **Things**, what this home keeps, how often each is used, its state and whether it is offered (admin token)
data-things.title: Things

data-week.more: One drawing per issue and distance over the last seven days, each against the issue's own line.

en: Was this week better or worse than usual?
Which day was the worst this week?
es: ¿Esta semana fue mejor o peor de lo normal?
¿Qué día fue el peor de la semana?
id: Apakah minggu ini lebih baik atau lebih buruk dari biasanya?
Hari apa yang paling buruk minggu ini?

data-week.quote: Then every issue at every distance over seven days, and the hours over the line per day
data-week.title: Seven days at every distance

dial.more: The rungs that may leave the machine are drawn as a dotted texture rather than the cells blue, so blue keeps its one meaning on this page: an H3 cell. Under the ladder, a fold draws one cell at the rung you are on against the rungs either side, to scale, and what each thing this node speaks for costs to cover at it.

en: Which rung is this page reading at?
Why may the coarse rungs leave the machine?
es: ¿En qué peldaño está leyendo esta página?
¿Por qué los peldaños gruesos pueden salir de la máquina?
id: Di anak tangga mana halaman ini membaca?
Mengapa anak tangga yang kasar boleh keluar dari mesin?

dial.quote: The **ladder** sits above the lead: eleven rungs, one per H3 resolution from 2 to 12, opening at 8. Rungs coarse enough that a cell may leave the machine (resolution 6 and coarser, the presence floor) are dotted rather than blue, and rungs finer than the node says where it is are struck through.
dial.title: The ladder: one rung per resolution

dido.more: On this page the rule is small enough to check: every request this page made of anywhere but this node is in the ledger below, and the plan base makes none. What the node itself sends upward, and to whom, is on the Network view.

en: What data comes in to this node?
What data goes out, and how coarse is it?
es: ¿Qué datos entran en este nodo?
¿Qué datos salen, y con qué detalle?
id: Data apa yang masuk ke node ini?
Data apa yang keluar, dan seberapa kasar?

dido.quote:
The rule it runs on is Fab City's rule for production, applied to data. Fab City calls the old pattern PITO,
product in, trash out, and the one it builds DIDO, data in, data out: materials stay in the city and knowledge
moves between cities.
dido.title: Data in, data out

distances.more: The page prints them as house, street, ring and region, on one scale, so the eye can answer whether it is me or everywhere without arithmetic.

en: What are the four distances for this house?
Which distance is missing here, and why?
es: ¿Cuáles son las cuatro distancias de esta casa?
¿Qué distancia falta aquí, y por qué?
id: Apa empat jarak untuk rumah ini?
Jarak mana yang tidak ada di sini, dan mengapa?

distances.quote:
**The four distances.** Where a reading comes from, nearest first. The wire keys are `room` (local, indoor),
`yard` (local, outdoor), `ring` (somebody else's device near here) and `region` (a model, a portal). The page
prints them as house · street · ring · region; in Bahasa, rumah · jalan · sekitar · wilayah.
distances.title: Four distances, not four resolutions

earth.more: The years come from files this node already holds, read through GET /earth, and the node fetches none of them while you look. `planetai run earth fetch` is how a year gets here.

en: What changed on the ground around here?
Why can the satellite not say what changed?
es: ¿Qué cambió en el terreno de alrededor?
¿Por qué el satélite no puede decir qué cambió?
id: Apa yang berubah di tanah sekitar sini?
Mengapa satelit tidak bisa mengatakan apa yang berubah?

earth.quote:
The node's own copy of Google's AlphaEarth Satellite Embedding layers for its square of the planet, and the
year-over-year per-pixel change computed here from them: cosine distance at 10 m. The node downloads them once,
on command, keeps them as files and compares them with arithmetic. It says something changed, never what.
earth.title: It says something changed, never what

effect.more: One row per rule, read from GET /effect over the whole record: how many acts, and how many were followed by the condition stopping. A recovery time in hours appears only for a rule that declares what it watches.

en: Which of our actions seem to work?
Why is elapsed time not an effect?
es: ¿Cuáles de nuestras acciones parecen funcionar?
¿Por qué el tiempo transcurrido no es un efecto?
id: Tindakan kita mana yang tampaknya berhasil?
Mengapa waktu yang berlalu bukan efek?

effect.quote:
It is elapsed time, not an effect. A window opened at 21:00 and air that cleared at 03:00 may be the window or
may be the night, and the node cannot tell.
effect.title: Elapsed time, not an effect

events.more: Decide is the first section under the lead. The numeral is red only when the peak is past the issue's line, and the action and the message are the node's words, in the household's language: this page holds no copy of either.

en: What is an alert event, and how is it different from an alert?
Why is there one card for several rule rows?
es: ¿Qué es un evento de alerta, y en qué se diferencia de una alerta?
¿Por qué hay una sola tarjeta para varias filas de reglas?
id: Apa itu kejadian peringatan, dan apa bedanya dengan peringatan?
Mengapa hanya ada satu kartu untuk beberapa baris aturan?

events.quote: An event is the bot's own unit: one issue in one house, from when its rule first fires to when it clears, however many rule rows that took. Decide draws one card for each open event: the peak with its comparisons, the action the node chose, and the message it sent.
events.title: What an alert event is

figure.more: The figure reads the node's own 24 hourly values for every distance, the usual for each hour from usual_by_hour, and the alert events from /issues. The page draws them; all it counts is the hours over the line and above the usual that it draws.

en: What does the grey band mean?
Which hours were over the line today?
es: ¿Qué significa la banda gris?
¿Qué horas pasaron la línea hoy?
id: Apa arti pita abu-abu itu?
Jam berapa saja yang melewati garis hari ini?

figure.quote:
Each issue with a day has one drawing of its last 24 hours. Every distance is a trace, the house heavier, and an hour
with no record is a gap in its trace. The grey band is the usual for each hour, from the
node's own last 14 days.
figure.title: The day, drawn once

figures.more: Every row here arrived in GET /issues as provenance: the figure, its value, where it came from, the node's word for it and its age. A script or a spreadsheet reads the same route, with a token, or with none at SHARE_LEVEL=open.

en: Where does each number on this page come from?
Can I read these figures from my own tools?
es: ¿De dónde sale cada cifra de esta página?
¿Puedo leer estas cifras con mis propias herramientas?
id: Dari mana setiap angka di halaman ini berasal?
Bisakah saya membaca angka ini dari alat saya sendiri?

figures.quote: Every node exposes the same API on port 8080. The dashboard, the `planetai` command, the MCP tools, a NAS pulling backups, Home Assistant and a parent node are all clients of it, and none of them has a private path in.
figures.title: One API, and no private path in

foot.more: The links here go to the documentation, to Set up and to today's open file, which anyone on your network can download at every sharing level.

en: What is in today's open data file?
Where can I read how this node works?
es: ¿Qué hay en el archivo de datos abiertos de hoy?
¿Dónde puedo leer cómo funciona este nodo?
id: Apa isi berkas data terbuka hari ini?
Di mana saya bisa membaca cara kerja node ini?

foot.quote:
The foot closes every door but the Wall: what the node is in one line, its version, the documentation and "These pages,
explained" (this page), `llms.txt` for agents, Ask the node, Set up, **Unlock this screen**, today's open export (CC BY
4.0) and links to PLANETAI, Fab City and the source.
foot.title: The foot of the page

forecast.more: The card is drawn from GET /forecast: the wind and the rain for the hours ahead, and a forecast point more than 10 km from the node is said to be another place. Nothing on this card can raise an alert.

en: What is the forecast for the next hours?
Why is a forecast context and not a prediction?
es: ¿Cuál es el pronóstico para las próximas horas?
¿Por qué un pronóstico es contexto y no una predicción?
id: Apa prakiraan untuk beberapa jam ke depan?
Mengapa prakiraan adalah konteks, bukan ramalan?

forecast.quote:
Official and model weather for this point over the next day, wind direction and rain, as context for reading
the node's own air. It fetches and does not predict, and it never sends an alert.
forecast.title: Context, not a prediction

health.more: The version at the foot is the one GET /health reports. Open it from the foot to read what every screen here asks first: the node, its version, its cell at resolution 8, its last poll.

en: Is this node healthy right now?
What does a screen check first?
es: ¿Está sano este nodo ahora mismo?
¿Qué comprueba primero una pantalla?
id: Apakah node ini sehat sekarang?
Apa yang diperiksa layar pertama kali?

health.quote: What every screen in the house polls. Answers at every `SHARE_LEVEL` and never makes an outbound request of its own.
health.title: What every screen asks first

lead.more: The node computes and the page draws. A number this page worked out for itself would be a bug, which is why the sentence, the numeral and the state word all arrive from GET /issues.

en: Why does this issue lead tonight?
What would make another issue lead?
es: ¿Por qué este asunto va primero esta noche?
¿Qué haría que otro asunto fuera primero?
id: Mengapa isu ini memimpin malam ini?
Apa yang membuat isu lain memimpin?

lead.quote: The first thing on Now is the ladder, and under it the lead: the headline issue's kicker, its numeral and pictogram, a title with no number in it, a smaller tagline under the title, a why line and the rule.
lead.title: The lead

levels.more: An alert's acted_at stays null until a person acts and records it, with this page's button, the CLI, the bot, a radio or an agent. It is the one measurement the node cannot make itself.

en: What is the difference between act, warn and info?
Which alerts reach me on Telegram?
es: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre act, warn e info?
¿Qué alertas me llegan por Telegram?
id: Apa beda act, warn dan info?
Peringatan mana yang sampai ke saya di Telegram?

levels.quote:
`ALERT_LEVEL` (default `act`) is the floor for interrupting a person, and `planetai report level warn` lowers it
without a restart. Below the floor an alert is still recorded, still drawn on the dashboard, and still in the
bundle the next [report](report.md) is written from.
levels.title: Three levels, one floor

mcp.more: The foot names POST /mcp for an agent handed this node's address: streamable HTTP, with Authorization: Bearer and the admin token on every call. `planetai agent` prints the snippet to paste into a client.

en: What can an agent do through MCP here?
Which tools are read, act and admin?
es: ¿Qué puede hacer un agente por MCP aquí?
¿Qué herramientas son read, act y admin?
id: Apa yang bisa dilakukan agen lewat MCP di sini?
Alat mana yang read, act dan admin?

mcp.quote:
This is the surface an agent holds. Any client that speaks MCP can read what the node read, ask how the place is
doing in the household's own words, and record that somebody acted, in that person's words. Nothing an agent does
through it takes a reading off the machine.
mcp.title: The surface an agent holds

mesh.more: What this card counts arrives through the gateway radio's MQTT uplink to this node's own broker. `planetai meshtastic` sets that up; with MESH_ALERTS=1 an act alert's first line goes back out over the mesh.

en: How does the mesh work without WiFi?
Which radios can hear this node?
es: ¿Cómo funciona la malla sin WiFi?
¿Qué radios pueden oír a este nodo?
id: Bagaimana mesh bekerja tanpa WiFi?
Radio mana yang bisa mendengar node ini?

mesh.quote:
For sensors and alerts where there is no WiFi. One gateway radio with WiFi uplinks the mesh to an MQTT broker on
the node, field radios carry a sensor on a battery, and a shelf radio paired to a phone receives alerts when the
internet is down.
mesh.title: Where there is no WiFi

node-around.more: The count says how many nodes are listed and how many this node's radio heard. A node joins the list with planetai hello and a merged pull request.

en: Which other nodes are near us?
How does our node join the list?
es: ¿Qué otros nodos hay cerca?
¿Cómo entra nuestro nodo en la lista?
id: Node lain mana yang dekat dengan kami?
Bagaimana node kami bisa masuk daftar?

node-around.quote:
Every node reads the file from the repository's `main` once an hour and serves it at `GET /nodes`, with only
the name, place, scale, operator, `since` and cell, and each point rounded to one decimal; `contact`, `sources`
and `parent` stay in the file. The Node door and the phone's walk draw the nodes from it.
node-around.title: The nodes around it

node-cells.more: A cell is live only when it was measured here in the last day. A model or a neighbour's numbers never make one live.

en: What is the Fab City Index?
Why are some cells only partial?
es: ¿Qué es el Índice Fab City?
¿Por qué algunas celdas aparecen como parciales?
id: Apa itu Fab City Index?
Mengapa beberapa sel hanya sebagian?

node-cells.quote: the Index cells this node computes from its hourly buckets, "N of 20", each with its value and provenance word
node-cells.title: Fab City Index cells

node-flow.more: Your sources come in on one side and what leaves goes out on the other, at their real rate. Raw readings stay here; a dashed line is one nobody turned on.

en: What does this node send out, and to whom?
Where do our readings come from?
es: ¿Qué envía este nodo hacia fuera, y a quién?
¿De dónde vienen nuestras lecturas?
id: Apa yang dikirim node ini keluar, dan kepada siapa?
Dari mana bacaan kami berasal?

node-flow.quote: the node as a hexagon, its sources on one side and what leaves on the other, replaying the last six hours in 30 s (24 hours on a press). Drawn vertically under 700 px
node-flow.title: What comes in, what goes out

node-globe.more: Each listed node lights its own coarse cell on the planet's grid, with a line from this node to every other node that has a point.

en: Where are the other nodes in the world?
Why is our place shown as such a big cell?
es: ¿Dónde están los otros nodos en el mundo?
¿Por qué nuestro lugar aparece como una celda tan grande?
id: Di mana saja node lain di dunia?
Mengapa tempat kami ditampilkan sebagai sel yang begitu besar?

node-globe.quote: the nodes listed and heard by radio, then a globe at most a third of the screen high
node-globe.title: The globe

node-refusals.more: Each refusal on this door links to where you can check it yourself: the flow, the cells, the ledger, the machine and the nodes around.

en: Can anyone see our raw readings?
Could an agent act for us without asking?
es: ¿Alguien puede ver nuestras lecturas en bruto?
¿Podría un agente actuar por nosotros sin preguntar?
id: Bisakah orang lain melihat bacaan mentah kami?
Bisakah agen bertindak atas nama kami tanpa bertanya?

node-refusals.quote:
No raw readings leave the instance that recorded them. No cell is upgraded from `mock` or `partial` to `live`
by aggregation. No agent dispatches without a human row in `actions`. No layer requires a cloud provider to
function. No scale is skipped: a city aggregator is built from nodes, not declared from above.
node-refusals.section: Refusals that hold at every stage
node-refusals.title: What this node will not do

node-remember.more: Under the diary and what is usual sit What worked and Who lives here. All of it needs the admin token and none of it leaves this machine.

en: What has the node learned about our house?
What happened in the house last week?
es: ¿Qué ha aprendido el nodo sobre nuestra casa?
¿Qué pasó en casa la semana pasada?
id: Apa yang sudah dipelajari node tentang rumah kami?
Apa yang terjadi di rumah minggu lalu?

node-remember.quote: admin token only, and never leaves the machine: the **Diary** as a table by day, week, month or year, each entry opening as the node wrote it, with a search; **What is usual** (the shape of the day inside and out, the week against the three before)
node-remember.title: What it remembers

node-running.more: The version, the uptime and the readings since the last restart, then the processor, memory and disk, which need the token. Set up › Machine has the full view.

en: How long will the disk last?
Is the machine working too hard?
es: ¿Cuánto le queda al disco?
¿La máquina está trabajando al límite?
id: Berapa lama lagi ruang disk-nya cukup?
Apakah mesinnya bekerja terlalu berat?

node-running.quote: the version and schema, how long since the restart and the polls since, then, with the token, the processor, memory, temperature and disk, with how long the disk lasts, and the mesh in the house
node-running.title: Running

node-verdict.more: The verdict is the node's own check of its last poll, its loop and its sensors. Under it, the version, how long it has run and the cell it stands in.

en: Is the node working properly?
Which sensor has gone quiet?
es: ¿Está funcionando bien el nodo?
¿Qué sensor ha dejado de enviar datos?
id: Apakah node bekerja dengan baik?
Sensor mana yang berhenti mengirim data?

node-verdict.quote:
A
poll older than 15 minutes, a loop that failed on its last run, a sensor of its own not heard in the last hour, or,
with the token, a fundamental source not running (`GET /health/sources`) turns it into "Needs a look", saying which,
with a link to finish setting up.
node-verdict.title: Working, or needs a look

note.more: Each row here is one of those records, newest first: who, which stage, how long ago, and decided first where a decision came before the act.

en: What should my note say?
Who reads the notes I write?
es: ¿Qué debería decir mi nota?
¿Quién lee las notas que escribo?
id: Apa yang harus ditulis dalam catatan saya?
Siapa yang membaca catatan yang saya tulis?

note.quote: `planetai act` is the terminal's way of closing a loop, and the note is the only record of what was done.
note.title: The note is the record

now-around.more: Press a station to open its readings in Data. Without WebGL the map is drawn as a rose of bearings and distances instead.

en: Is the air outside worse than in our house?
Which station near us has the dirtiest air?
es: ¿El aire de fuera está peor que el de casa?
¿Qué estación cercana tiene el aire más sucio?
id: Apakah udara di luar lebih buruk daripada di rumah kami?
Stasiun mana di dekat kami yang udaranya paling kotor?

now-around.quote:
Under them, the map of the stations around the house: each public
station with its 15-minute mean, a red square beside one over the air's line, the house as one mark with its own
sensors' range, and the distance rings and cells for a screen with the token.
now-around.title: The stations around the house

now-distances.more: Each distance carries its own provenance word, so you can see which number was measured in this house and which came from a public station or a model.

en: Is it worse inside or outside right now?
What was it like at this hour yesterday?
es: ¿Ahora está peor dentro o fuera de casa?
¿Cómo estaba ayer a esta misma hora?
id: Sekarang lebih buruk di dalam atau di luar rumah?
Bagaimana keadaannya pada jam yang sama kemarin?

now-distances.quote:
The four distances follow as one quiet line; a distance with no reading says `none` or `not recorded`. Point at
an hour, drag across the day, or use the arrow keys (left and right an hour, up and down a day, End for now): the
sentence, the distances and Decide follow the hour, and **Back to now** returns.
now-distances.title: House, street, ring and region

now-rows.more: Each row carries the node's state word, the value now and today's hours over the line. Press one and the whole door moves to that issue.

en: Which of these needs a look today?
Was it too hot or the air too dirty at any hour today?
es: ¿Cuál de estos hay que mirar hoy?
¿Hubo alguna hora hoy con demasiado calor o el aire muy sucio?
id: Mana di antara ini yang perlu diperhatikan hari ini?
Apakah hari ini ada jam yang terlalu panas atau udaranya terlalu kotor?

now-rows.quote:
**Around the house.** A row for each issue drawn by the hour, its state word, its value now and its hours over the line
today; pressing one moves the page to that issue.
now-rows.title: Every issue, a row each

now-sentence.more: The sentence is the node's own, in the house's language, and the pill beside the time says where its number comes from. The cell at the right of the kicker opens Place.

en: What does the node want me to know right now?
Is this number measured in our house?
es: ¿Qué quiere decirme el nodo ahora mismo?
¿Esta cifra se mide en nuestra casa?
id: Apa yang ingin disampaikan node kepada saya sekarang?
Apakah angka ini diukur di rumah kami?

now-sentence.quote:
**Right now.** A kicker ("Right now · Heat at 19:00" and the provenance pill), then the sentence and the day as one
block: the issue's sign, the node's title (no number in it) with its tagline smaller beneath, and the
[day figure](#the-day-figure) with the week under it.
now-sentence.title: Right now

now-things.more: The line counts the things, how many sit idle and how many need repair, and opens the list in Data › Home. Only a thing you mark to lend or give is ever published.

en: Which of our things need repair?
What could we lend to a neighbour?
es: ¿Qué cosas nuestras necesitan arreglo?
¿Qué podríamos prestarle a un vecino?
id: Barang kami mana yang perlu diperbaiki?
Apa yang bisa kami pinjamkan ke tetangga?

now-things.quote:
With the admin token one line counts the things this home
keeps, how many sit idle and how many need repair, and opens Data › Home.
now-things.title: What this home keeps

now-todo.more: Press the one that is true: Done when you did it, Not now to be asked again in three hours, Doesn't fit when it does not apply here. Your answer is the first row in Data › Ledger.

en: What should I do about this now?
What happens if I leave it for later?
es: ¿Qué debería hacer ahora?
¿Qué pasa si lo dejo para más tarde?
id: Apa yang sebaiknya saya lakukan sekarang?
Apa yang terjadi kalau saya menundanya?

now-todo.quote:
**What to do.** While the node is asking (`asking` on the issue in `/issues`), a framed card: the issue, the kind of
event and when it began, the peak against the line, the action the node chose in its own words, and **Done**, **Not
now** and **Doesn't fit**.
now-todo.title: What to do

now-worked.more: This part shows only with the admin token, because it is the house's own record. The whole diary and every case are on Node, under What it remembers.

en: Did what we did last time help?
How was yesterday in the house?
es: ¿Sirvió lo que hicimos la última vez?
¿Cómo estuvo ayer la casa?
id: Apakah yang kami lakukan terakhir kali membantu?
Bagaimana keadaan rumah kemarin?

now-worked.quote:
**Did it work** and **Yesterday** (admin token only). For the issue on screen: the last time the node asked, what was
done, what the air or heat inside did in the hours after against the street, and the node's verdict from what it
learned ("It helps here.", "No clear difference here yet.", "Too early to say.")
now-worked.title: Did it work, and yesterday

parent.more: The wires on the right are what leaves this node: hourly means to a parent, the Index cells and ρ. A wire with nothing on it is dashed. `planetai config set PARENT_API_URL` and `PARENT_TOKEN` give this node a parent.

en: What does this node send to its district?
How does this cell join the Index?
es: ¿Qué envía este nodo a su distrito?
¿Cómo entra esta celda en el Índice?
id: Apa yang dikirim node ini ke distriknya?
Bagaimana sel ini bergabung dengan Index?

parent.quote:
With a parent set, a house becomes one cell in a district's picture
without its readings leaving the house: every hour it sends up hourly means and the timestamps of its alerts,
and nothing else.
parent.title: One cell in a district's picture

place-changed.more: Each square is ten hectares the node's AlphaEarth record marks as changed between two years, and the share of built ground, trees, crops and water within 1 km sits beside them.

en: How much land around us changed this year?
Are we losing trees around here?
es: ¿Cuánto terreno cambió a nuestro alrededor este año?
¿Se están perdiendo árboles por aquí?
id: Seberapa banyak lahan di sekitar kami yang berubah tahun ini?
Apakah pepohonan di sekitar sini berkurang?

place-changed.quote: the hectares that changed year on year (one square per 10 ha), and what the ground within 1 km is made of: built, trees, crops, water, by satellite
place-changed.title: What changed

place-changing.more: Land and coast change yearly, so they are here and not on Now. What the node cannot read yet is named here as missing.

en: Is the coast near us changing?
What can this node not measure yet?
es: ¿Está cambiando la costa cerca de nosotros?
¿Qué no puede medir todavía este nodo?
id: Apakah pantai di dekat kami berubah?
Apa yang belum bisa diukur node ini?

place-changing.quote:
**What is
changing**: land and coast with the node's sentence and figure, the Index cells, and what is not here yet (production
and trade, water and soil).
place-changing.title: What is changing

place-head.more: The cell id is printed whole. The three buttons switch between the map, the satellite then and now, and what changed year on year.

en: How big is the area this node covers?
What does the satellite show changed here?
es: ¿Qué tamaño tiene la zona que cubre este nodo?
¿Qué cambió aquí según el satélite?
id: Seberapa luas area yang dicakup node ini?
Menurut satelit, apa yang berubah di sini?

place-head.quote:
The ground this node stands on. The head gives the cell's id, resolution, edge and area (and the node's position, for
a screen with the token), and three views:
place-head.title: The ground this node stands on

place-image.more: The picture stays on this node, cleaned of EXIF and GPS, and lands on the map where its own GPS says it was taken, else in the node's cell.

en: What happens to a photo I add here?
Can the node tell me what plant this is?
es: ¿Qué pasa con una foto que subo aquí?
¿Puede el nodo decirme qué planta es esta?
id: Apa yang terjadi pada foto yang saya tambahkan di sini?
Bisakah node memberi tahu saya tanaman apa ini?

place-image.quote:
**+ Add an image** (token only) opens a dialog: the file, what took it (phone, fixed camera, microscope, drone, balloon
or kite), a note and your name, and whether the image model on this node describes it.
place-image.title: Add an image

place-layers.more: Eighteen layers in five groups sit in the strip. Press a group to open its rows and switch a layer on or off.

en: Which layer shows the public air stations?
Where does the street map come from?
es: ¿Qué capa muestra las estaciones públicas de aire?
¿De dónde sale el mapa de calles?
id: Lapisan mana yang menampilkan stasiun udara publik?
Dari mana peta jalan ini berasal?

place-layers.quote:
Each row has its swatch, what it draws and from where, its pack and its opacity. Five start
on: the street map, the node's cell, the house's stations, the public stations and the images. A layer whose pack has
nothing here says so.
place-layers.title: The layers

place-map.more: Every distance in the margin is measured by the node from its own point. Without the token the house's marks say withheld, because together they would place the house.

en: How far is the nearest station from our house?
Why are some marks hidden?
es: ¿A qué distancia de casa está la estación más cercana?
¿Por qué algunas marcas están ocultas?
id: Seberapa jauh stasiun terdekat dari rumah kami?
Mengapa beberapa tanda disembunyikan?

place-map.quote:
Nothing is labelled on the map itself: every mark leaves on a thin leader to a ruled margin, **At the house · by
position**, one row per mark with its distance in metres from the node, measured by the node (`GET /geo/measure`, and
`GET /nearby` for public stations).
place-map.title: The map and its margin

place-orbit.more: Two of the node's own Sentinel-2 years side by side, from files it already holds. Nothing is fetched while you look.

en: What did this place look like a few years ago?
Has there been more building around us?
es: ¿Cómo era este lugar hace unos años?
¿Se ha construido más a nuestro alrededor?
id: Seperti apa tempat ini beberapa tahun lalu?
Apakah bangunan di sekitar kami bertambah?

place-orbit.quote: the node's Sentinel-2 annual medians, then and now side by side, with the hectares that changed between them by its AlphaEarth record
place-orbit.title: From orbit

place-reach.more: Each row is one kind of source with the oldest and newest hour this node holds for it, and under them the public stations within 5 km.

en: How long has this node been measuring here?
Which public stations are close to us?
es: ¿Desde cuándo mide este nodo aquí?
¿Qué estaciones públicas tenemos cerca?
id: Sudah berapa lama node ini mengukur di sini?
Stasiun publik mana yang dekat dengan kami?

place-reach.quote:
**Where the readings come from**: how far back each kind of source reaches, from
`GET /reach`, and the public stations within 5 km.
place-reach.title: Where the readings come from

place-species.more: Only what a person here confirmed in an image is counted. Where a picture was taken places the house, so the table needs the token.

en: Which plants and animals have we found here?
What else lives around here, by other people's records?
es: ¿Qué plantas y animales hemos encontrado aquí?
¿Qué más vive por aquí, según lo que otros han registrado?
id: Tumbuhan dan hewan apa saja yang sudah kami temukan di sini?
Menurut catatan orang lain, makhluk apa lagi yang hidup di sekitar sini?

place-species.quote:
**Species confirmed here**: a table of what somebody here confirmed
in an image, how often, where, and GBIF's open records by others in the node's seven cells, token only.
place-species.title: Species confirmed here

place-tools.more: Press a mark, a margin row or a cell and its facts appear in this line. Measure and From the house ask the node for the distance, so the page never works one out itself.

en: How far is that point from the house?
What cell is this, and how big is it?
es: ¿A qué distancia de la casa está ese punto?
¿Qué celda es esta y qué tamaño tiene?
id: Seberapa jauh titik itu dari rumah?
Sel apa ini, dan seberapa besar?

place-tools.quote:
press a station, an image, a place to make or a cell and the line gives its facts, and with the token how far it is
from the node and which cell it is in. A station of this house says it counts toward the cell; a public one is shown
and never counted.
place-tools.title: The inspector and the tools

presence.more: The cell drawn here is the one this node would announce, and its area is the whole of what a stranger on the radio learns. GET /presence answers with enabled false until RETICULUM_PRESENCE=1.

en: What does this node announce over radio?
How coarse is the cell it announces?
es: ¿Qué anuncia este nodo por radio?
¿Con qué detalle anuncia su celda?
id: Apa yang diumumkan node ini lewat radio?
Seberapa kasar sel yang diumumkannya?

presence.quote:
Presence is separate and off by default: with `RETICULUM_PRESENCE=1` the bridge announces the node's name and a
coarse H3 cell every half hour, at `RETICULUM_PRESENCE_RES` (3) and never finer than resolution 6, whatever the
setting says, so an exact place never leaves.
presence.title: A coarse cell, and never finer

production.more: The foot of every view but the wall opens on this sentence and the purpose that goes with it, quoted from the documentation rather than rewritten, so this page and the documentation say the same thing.

en: Why one computer per place?
What does distributed production mean for this house?
es: ¿Por qué un ordenador por lugar?
¿Qué significa la producción distribuida para esta casa?
id: Mengapa satu komputer untuk satu tempat?
Apa arti produksi terdistribusi bagi rumah ini?

production.quote:
PLANETAI is hyperlocal compute and intelligence for distributed production, and a node is its
unit: one computer per place, on hardware the place already owns.
production.title: One computer per place

prov.more: Provenance is ink only and square on this page, never a coloured pill, and the full H3 id is printed once per object and never truncated.

en: Which numbers here are live and which are modelled?
What does partial mean on this page?
es: ¿Qué cifras son en vivo y cuáles son de un modelo?
¿Qué significa parcial en esta página?
id: Angka mana yang langsung dan mana yang dimodelkan?
Apa arti sebagian di halaman ini?

prov.quote:
`live`: measured by this node, in the house or on the street. `partial`: derived, a portal, the ring.
`model`: a model row. `cached`: a committed fixture replayed through the node's own engine.
prov.title: Provenance words

purpose.more: Every number on this page answers to that purpose. The issues the lead can name are air, heat, land and coast; water and soil are not among them in this version, so the page draws neither.

en: What is this node for?
How does it help the air, water and soil here?
es: ¿Para qué sirve este nodo?
¿Cómo ayuda al aire, el agua y el suelo de aquí?
id: Untuk apa node ini?
Bagaimana node ini membantu udara, air dan tanah di sini?

purpose.quote:
Its purpose is
fixed: clean air, water and soil for the people and the other living things around each node.
purpose.title: What a node is for

raw.more: The strips under Observe are hourly means, one cell an hour: the finest time step this page shows, and still not a raw reading.

en: What leaves this machine, and what never does?
Where are the raw readings kept?
es: ¿Qué sale de esta máquina, y qué nunca sale?
¿Dónde se guardan las lecturas en bruto?
id: Apa yang keluar dari mesin ini, dan apa yang tidak pernah?
Di mana bacaan mentah disimpan?

raw.quote:
Raw readings stay. What travels is a summary: hourly means and alert timestamps to a parent node, if
`PARENT_API_URL` names one; the daily [export](storage.md), with hourly means, your own sensors named by role
(`indoor-1`, `outdoor-2`), the Index cells, each alert's first line, ρ, the household's offers and its res-8 cell's centre, never its
point, under CC BY 4.0
raw.section: What leaves the machine, and what never does
raw.title: Raw readings stay

reach.more: Each row is one kind of source, with the oldest and newest hourly mean this node holds for it, from GET /reach. The climate normals the node pulled at install are dated years before it was switched on; its own sensors start on the day they were first polled.

en: Where does this node's own line start?
Who does this node reach?
es: ¿Dónde empieza la línea propia de este nodo?
¿A quién llega este nodo?
id: Di mana garis node ini sendiri dimulai?
Siapa yang dijangkau node ini?

reach.quote:
This page puts the node itself on a machine: two containers, a database on this disk, and the loops that read
your place every five minutes. Once it is done the node has pulled the air model and the climate normals for
your coordinates, answers on port 8080, and keeps every reading it takes on this machine.
reach.title: Where this node's own line starts

refusals.more: The care label under Measure is those refusals as signs. Nothing to press on the wall is the wall's own refusal: it is an instruction, not a control.

en: What will this node always refuse to do?
Can an agent change a setting here?
es: ¿Qué se negará siempre a hacer este nodo?
¿Puede un agente cambiar un ajuste aquí?
id: Apa yang selalu ditolak node ini?
Bisakah agen mengubah pengaturan di sini?

refusals.quote:
No raw readings leave the instance that recorded them. No cell is upgraded from `mock` or `partial` to `live`
by aggregation. No agent dispatches without a human row in `actions`. No layer requires a cloud provider to
function. No scale is skipped: a city aggregator is built from nodes, not declared from above.
refusals.section: Refusals that hold at every stage
refusals.title: Refusals that hold at every stage

registry.more: The counts here are GET /sources, read the first time somebody opens Network: what the pinned registry lists for this place, how many entries have code on this node, and the places to make things and the designs to build. `planetai sources` prints the same list.

en: What else could be measured here?
Which open sources cover this place?
es: ¿Qué más se podría medir aquí?
¿Qué fuentes abiertas cubren este lugar?
id: Apa lagi yang bisa diukur di sini?
Sumber terbuka mana yang mencakup tempat ini?

registry.quote:
A node measures what its adapters read. The registry is the network's shared list of what could be measured at
each pillar and scale, and of the places a person could go to act on it, carried inside every node as a
pinned copy.
registry.title: What could be measured here

rho.more: The page draws it as the alerts answered over the alerts raised, with the median minutes to the first answer, and counts the rings rather than sizing them.

en: What is this node's ρ, and what counts toward it?
How do I close the loop on an alert?
es: ¿Cuál es la ρ de este nodo, y qué cuenta para ella?
¿Cómo cierro el ciclo de una alerta?
id: Berapa ρ node ini, dan apa yang dihitung?
Bagaimana saya menutup lingkaran pada sebuah peringatan?

rho.quote:
ρ (rho) is the share of the node's act-level asks (alerts and events it sent, and its children's alerts) that a
person answered within 24 hours. It is the node's
`Governance` cell in the Fab City Index, counted from the answers people give, each one a row in the `actions` table.
rho.title: ρ: the loop closed

settings.more: Each value here says where it came from. A value saved here is live within 20 seconds and wins over .env, a blank returns the key to .env, and every save is a row in actions with the actor dashboard.

en: Which setting should I look at first?
Who can change a setting, and how is it recorded?
es: ¿Qué ajuste debería mirar primero?
¿Quién puede cambiar un ajuste, y cómo queda registrado?
id: Pengaturan mana yang harus saya lihat dulu?
Siapa yang bisa mengubah pengaturan, dan bagaimana dicatat?

settings.quote:
A setting is a decision the household makes about its node: which sensors count as its own, what it
watches first, when it may interrupt somebody, what a stranger on the WiFi may read, whether a question
may leave the house for an online model.
settings.title: A setting is a decision

setup-save.more: A change that sends something beyond this machine, or runs code that is not the node's, waits for Save anyway, after a panel says what it does.

en: What happens when I save a setting?
How do I undo a change?
es: ¿Qué pasa cuando guardo un ajuste?
¿Cómo deshago un cambio?
id: Apa yang terjadi saat saya menyimpan pengaturan?
Bagaimana cara membatalkan perubahan?

setup-save.quote:
A save sends only the fields you edited. A value saved here is live within 20 seconds and wins over `.env`; a blank
returns the key to `.env`. Every change is an `actions` row with `stage='settings'` and the actor `dashboard`
setup-save.title: Saving a change

setup-sections.more: A section with something set here says how many. This screen says locked or unlocked.

en: Where do I change when the reports arrive?
How do I let every screen in the house read the node?
es: ¿Dónde cambio la hora de los informes?
¿Cómo dejo que todas las pantallas de casa lean el nodo?
id: Di mana saya mengubah jam laporan dikirim?
Bagaimana agar semua layar di rumah bisa membaca node?

setup-sections.quote:
The gear opens Set up, a page of its own with a sticky list of sections. The first eight are the setting groups;
the last four are about this screen and this machine.
setup-sections.title: The sections

shape.more: The page waits for seven local days before it names the worst hour, and until then says how many it has. GET /shape?metric=pm25 returns the same hours, with how many hourly means went into each.

en: What does a usual day look like here?
Is today different from the usual day?
es: ¿Cómo es un día normal aquí?
¿Es hoy distinto de un día normal?
id: Seperti apa hari biasa di sini?
Apakah hari ini berbeda dari biasanya?

shape.quote: The day this place usually has: one mean per local hour of day, over the whole record, indoor apart from outdoor. Only this node's own sensors (`local`) count.
shape.title: The day this place usually has

share.more: The request ledger below is this page confessing what it asked of the world while you looked at it. The offline plan asks nothing; Telegram is reached by the node, never by this page.

en: Who can read this page without a token?
What changes if SHARE_LEVEL is open?
es: ¿Quién puede leer esta página sin token?
¿Qué cambia si SHARE_LEVEL está en open?
id: Siapa yang bisa membaca halaman ini tanpa token?
Apa yang berubah jika SHARE_LEVEL terbuka?

share.quote:
`SHARE_LEVEL` says who on your network may read the node without a token, and it never sends anything
anywhere. Change it in Set up, with `planetai config set SHARE_LEVEL open`, or over MCP; it is live within 20
seconds.
share.title: Reach, not publishing

siting.more: These are the devices on this node's own ground, with their source, indoors or out, what each measures and when it last spoke. The row for an open hardware manager says what is not here yet: design files, firmware, and where nearby a device could be made or mended.

en: Where should a sensor go in this house?
Why is a sensor named for its place?
es: ¿Dónde debería ir un sensor en esta casa?
¿Por qué un sensor lleva el nombre de su lugar?
id: Di mana sebaiknya sensor ditaruh di rumah ini?
Mengapa sensor dinamai menurut tempatnya?

siting.quote:
Name it after the place: the name becomes the sensor's name
on the page and in every message. For the box, the outdoor sensor enclosure is printable, and Fab Lab Bali
prints it.
siting.title: Named for its place, in a box made nearby

stages.more: Observe, decide, act, measure: the four stages of the loop. Now draws Decide first, because what asks for a person is read first. A section whose data is not on this node prints one honest line in its place, never a blank and never a guess.

en: Where is this house in the loop right now?
What happens between deciding and acting?
es: ¿En qué punto del ciclo está esta casa ahora?
¿Qué pasa entre decidir y actuar?
id: Di mana rumah ini dalam lingkaran sekarang?
Apa yang terjadi antara memutuskan dan bertindak?

stages.quote: Every section is registered with the page contract: `id`, `pack`, `stage`, `title`, `reads` and `render` (or `lead`). The shell draws each one in the stage it belongs to. The loop runs observe, decide, act, measure, and Now draws Decide first.
stages.title: The order the loop runs

states.more: State is carried by weight, fill and dash, never by hue: act is set at 700 and the other states at 500. Colour is argument only: blue a cell, green a loop closed, red a line crossed.

en: What state is each issue in tonight?
Why are states not shown in colour?
es: ¿En qué estado está cada asunto esta noche?
¿Por qué los estados no se muestran con color?
id: Dalam keadaan apa setiap isu malam ini?
Mengapa keadaan tidak ditunjukkan dengan warna?

states.quote: For every issue the keeper declared in `NODE_ISSUES` (an undeclared one is still shown, as `watched: false`), the node computes a `state`: `act` (something is asked), `notable` (something changed), `quiet`, `context` (an issue that informs and never asks) or `none` (no record).
states.title: States, in weight not hue

strips.more: The strips read GET /issues/days: the same hourly values the lead uses, over up to 90 days, with the node's own count of hours over the line for each day.

en: At what hour is the air usually worst here?
Which days were over the line?
es: ¿A qué hora suele estar peor el aire aquí?
¿Qué días pasaron la línea?
id: Jam berapa udara biasanya paling buruk di sini?
Hari apa saja yang melewati garis?

strips.quote:
One row a day and one cell an hour, the newest day at the bottom: the last seven days under each day figure, and every
day the node holds on Historical.
strips.title: One row a day, one cell an hour

tiles.more: The request count sits in the tab bar so the price of switching to satellite is visible before you pay it: live tiles need MAP_TILES=on, and a press may only ever reduce it.

en: What does the satellite map send, and to whom?
Why is the offline plan the default?
es: ¿Qué envía el mapa satelital, y a quién?
¿Por qué el plano sin conexión es el predeterminado?
id: Apa yang dikirim peta satelit, dan kepada siapa?
Mengapa denah luring menjadi bawaan?

tiles.quote: Three bases: `plan`, offline, from `/place/geojson` (the building footprints within `PLACE_RADIUS_M`, drawn in the browser, nothing leaving the house); `sat`, Sentinel-2 cloudless tiles; `osm`, OpenStreetMap tiles.
tiles.title: What a map costs

trust.more: The figures here are GET /trust, one row per local sensor: its coverage over seven days, the channels that stopped moving, and how old the sensor is, which explains a low coverage without a fault.

en: Are this node's sensors telling the truth?
Which sensor looks stuck or silent?
es: ¿Dicen la verdad los sensores de este nodo?
¿Qué sensor parece atascado o callado?
id: Apakah sensor node ini jujur?
Sensor mana yang tampak macet atau diam?

trust.quote:
Whether the node's own sensors are telling it the truth: coverage over the last week, channels that have
stopped changing under a kit that still reports, and collocated sensors that disagree about the level.
trust.title: Whether its own sensors tell the truth

wall-map.more: The caption under the map says in words what the red discs mean against the house, at the hour they show.

en: Which way is the wind blowing?
What do the red circles mean?
es: ¿Hacia dónde sopla el viento?
¿Qué significan los círculos rojos?
id: Ke arah mana angin bertiup?
Apa arti lingkaran merah itu?

wall-map.quote:
**The map**: the stations around the house on the node's own map, framed on the scale's H3 cell, with the wind. The
  house is one mark and a public station a disc, red when it is over the line.
wall-map.title: The map

wall-narration.more: A new text comes every ten minutes from the model chosen in Set up › Model, and the box says it is a model's words, written from the node's figures.

en: What does the node suggest for today?
Which model writes this text?
es: ¿Qué sugiere el nodo para hoy?
¿Qué modelo escribe este texto?
id: Apa saran node untuk hari ini?
Model mana yang menulis teks ini?

wall-narration.quote:
The node tells it to speak like a calm neighbour in six to eight plain sentences: what is happening
inside, how it compares with the street and the neighbourhood, what it suggests for an ordinary day, and what the next
hours may bring, with no units, at most two numbers, and never saying that anything is safe.
wall-narration.title: The node, thinking aloud

wall-never.more: That is why this screen holds no token and no button. An answer belongs on Telegram, the radio or the other doors.

en: Why does this screen not name the rooms?
Can a guest see anything private here?
es: ¿Por qué esta pantalla no nombra las habitaciones?
¿Puede un invitado ver algo privado aquí?
id: Mengapa layar ini tidak menyebut nama ruangan?
Bisakah tamu melihat sesuatu yang pribadi di sini?

wall-never.quote:
Anyone in the room reads the Wall, so it names no sensor, room, kit or person, and the model's facts carry none of
them either. What is asked is the node's own sentence, never the alert's text, which can name a room. It never shows
what the house learned, its diary, its things, a position or a button to answer.
wall-never.title: What the Wall never shows

wall-page.more: At the house it draws each issue and the day inside, at the street what is usual outside, at the ring the land within 1 km, and at the region what the satellites see.

en: What is the land around us made of?
Are there fires nearby?
es: ¿De qué está hecho el terreno de alrededor?
¿Hay incendios cerca?
id: Tanah di sekitar kami terdiri dari apa saja?
Apakah ada kebakaran di dekat sini?

wall-page.quote:
Every figure says when it is from and carries a provenance word. A figure from `/observations` takes the node's rule
for readouts (`model` for a model, `partial` otherwise), and what the node learned is `partial`. A source is named the
way the Wall says it ("Sea, 5 km off"), and a sensor's name never appears.
wall-page.title: The page for each scale

wall-sentence.more: When the node's last poll is more than 15 minutes old, the time says the readings are old.

en: Is anything being asked of us right now?
Are these readings fresh?
es: ¿Se nos está pidiendo algo ahora?
¿Son recientes estas lecturas?
id: Apakah ada yang diminta dari kami sekarang?
Apakah bacaan ini masih baru?

wall-sentence.quote:
**The time and the sentence**: the headline issue's title as the node writes it, with what is asked now beside it:
  the node's own sentence, how many things are asked of the house, and "Answer on Telegram, not here.", or "Nothing is
  asked now."
wall-sentence.title: The time and the sentence

wall-walk.more: House, street, ring and region, each framed on its own cell. With reduced motion on, the Wall holds the street at the last hour.

en: Why does the map keep moving out?
How do I keep it on our street?
es: ¿Por qué el mapa se va alejando?
¿Cómo lo dejo quieto en nuestra calle?
id: Mengapa peta terus bergerak menjauh?
Bagaimana agar peta tetap di jalan kami?

wall-walk.quote:
Each scale holds while its day is replayed, 24 hours in 30 s, then the walk cuts to the next. A new scale is a cut,
never a flight. The four scale names on the map say which one is drawn: pressing one holds it, pressing it again lets
the walk go on.
wall-walk.title: The walk, a scale at a time

workshop.more: In Act, under the record of what was asked, the row with the nearest fab lab is that sentence where the pack is on: the lab, how far, and the dated archive it came from. With MAKE_ENABLED off, the row is the node's own help text for that setting instead.

en: Where is the nearest place to make something?
Why does the node point to a workshop?
es: ¿Dónde está el lugar más cercano para fabricar algo?
¿Por qué el nodo señala un taller?
id: Di mana tempat terdekat untuk membuat sesuatu?
Mengapa node menunjuk ke bengkel?

workshop.quote:
The `make` pack names the nearest fab lab in a sentence, and no
node has handed a job to a workshop yet. What runs is the loop from a reading to a person acting and a
measured result; the loop from a reading to something made nearby is the direction.
workshop.title: The nearest place to make it
